_about: The rooms' surfaces as 0.69d names them (the owner, 2026-11-16: "let's not change things unless 0.69 does so"; of the Chemical Plant's tracks: "I don't like this, original is fine", so they stay). A triangle's material is its face name's game_material_settings/<name>/game_material_id in its model's settings, read when the collision is cooked (collision_shape_cook 0x82590); the material is the step's and the bullet's (its armor, ricochet, pierce), so this changes what a match computes (simulation_changes.tsv). Faces with no material that 0.69d's settings name: Radar's garage_inside (metall_thick, concrete, gravel, metall_thin, wood_silent) and the Fort's center_part_01_floor (gravel, ground; its walker face ground); Vector's centre_lab_dome (its one face name, 'default', has no entry in 0.26g's settings: 3FFFh) gets 0.69d's entry, the material default (11). The names stay as they are ("not assigned or deleted"): the cook reads the id. Four faces 0.69d gives another material (the owner, 2026-11-21: yes to the silent-surface census's four): School's anomaly_fruit FUIT_s grass_soft -> grass, Mamayev's level/06_v1 ground_3 'grass' glass -> grass, the Chemical Plant's moss4 anomaly_moss_base_sg mud -> grass, London's building_03 coll_wood wood_tree -> wood_thin; their names follow (each the file's only string of that value); 0.69d's other renamed faces are not taken (ground_3's new walker_col_walk entry among them). Mamayev's monument and statue_ground, the Fort's out_wall_base_a_2, London's building_07_3 and building_06_1_indoor_01's stucco have no material in 0.69d either and stay as they are.
